content.value: A man's exercise habits are as follows. If he does his exercise one day, he is 70% sure not to do them the next day. On the other hand, if he does not do his exercise one day, he is 60% sure not to do them the next day. Find out;opär
(i) the probability of doing exercise after three days;
(ii) In the long run, how often does he do his exercise?
